purpose: Which commit was audited, what the audit said, who reviewed it and what the first upload actually produced. This is the audit state the closure clause requires to be reproducible from a clone: the audited HEAD is re-read with `git rev-parse HEAD` by tests/unified/test_v20_inrepo_evidence.py, and a hand-typed SHA cannot survive that comparison.
observed_from: git and the filesystem, read by scripts/build_audit_state.py
